## Description

[Variable table by origin (original / external / engineered) and type
(numerical, categorical, temporal, text). See `docs/data-dictionary.md`.]

```{python}
#| label: tbl-state-overview
#| tbl-cap: "Overview of the processed state table (computed at render time)."
if STATE_PATH.exists():
    state = pd.read_parquet(STATE_PATH)
    overview = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "Statistic": ["Rows", "States", "Years", "Distinct names", "Published births", "Missing cells"],
            "Value": [
                f"{len(state):,}",
                state["state"].nunique(),
                f"{state['year'].min()}–{state['year'].max()}",
                f"{state['name'].nunique():,}",
                f"{state['count'].sum():,}",
                int(state.isna().sum().sum()),
            ],
        }
    )
    display(overview.style.hide(axis="index"))
else:
    print("data/processed/state.parquet not found: run scripts/build_dataset.py")
```
